audio.motor: Load-gated restrained sine harmonics, fundamental 58–124 Hz; no idle gain floor; zero demand/neutral/off/brake/park mute drive layer.
audio.mix: Exterior tyre bed; cabin road amplitude 0.09–0.13 of exterior plus 310 Hz low-pass. Motor cabin low-pass 190 Hz; exterior 330 Hz.
audio.road: Distance-based sparse low-speed grain envelope fades into continuous bed as speed increases; reverse/coasting remain audible.
audio.fixedStep: Keep previous drive-force sample on render frames without a new 60 Hz physics step. Keyboard demand uses drivetrain target, not analogue-only field.

audio.assets: 7/7 decoded and ACTIVE in final live run
audio.scope: Soft stylized synthesized EV drive layer over existing CC0 road recordings; not an OEM motor recording. Automated graph and live telemetry verification, no claim of subjective listening.

chassis.frame: Shell, knuckles and steering axes share full terrain pitch and bank. Wheel hubs move only along bounded chassis-local suspension Y.
chassis.loads: Per-corner gravity and acceleration loads, bounded spring/damper response. Gravity bias follows the downhill end regardless of reverse velocity.
chassis.contact: Oriented finite-width cylinder support for terrain and kerbs; downhill heave transports continuous terrain motion before spring response.
chassis.rollover: Sustained pressure-centre escape hands whole vehicle to Cannon rigid-body contact/gravity. Verified on a 60-degree test heightfield, not interactively on every map slope.
chassis.worldTests: All five GLBs: two real kerb-side points and four mountain heading/bank points; actual exported tyre vertices checked against solid kerbs.
chassis.live: L80 left/right 22.5 degree banks; Tai7 uphill and downhill roll; four contact gaps reported approximately zero.
chassis.limits: Game-calibrated CoM/spring/damping, not manufacturer suspension maps or a full multi-link / deformable tyre solver.

development: Force remount on hot edits; clear audio references on disposal; avoid stale native audio graphs and old render closures.
